description: This file defines a specification class 'CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification' that extends from 'Specification<CatalogItem>' to facilitate filtered and paginated retrieval of catalog items based on brand and type IDs.

classes.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
classes.description: A specification class for filtering and paginating catalog items based on brand and type IDs.

methods.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the specification with filters for brand and type, with support for pagination through skip and take parameters.
